Name: Frontliner's Baton March
Components: V, M (a glass shard from a broken picture holder)
Description: You conjure forth a plume of reddish smoke that lingers on the feet of your target, spreading outwards with movement and reinvigorating spirits as if it were a flare to focus aim onto a single victorious future. The target gains an additional 15-ft. of movement speed until the end of their next turn. At the start of their turn they gain 2 Poise count and gain an additional 2 count for each friendly creature they first enter within 5-ft. of until the end of their turn. Creatures passed by this way gain an amount of Poise count at the end of the runner’s turn equal to 2 + the amount of creatures passed by.
